status.note: Still pre-opening: the site says 'Coming Soon to Hillman City' and local coverage says the brewery-pizzeria won't open until 2027, with pop-up slice events in the meantime.
Online ordering is live with a full current menu and an active 'Order Ahead' button for the Howell St location.
The trailer now operates from a fixed Westwood address with daily 8am-5:30pm hours and shows as open now.

The business's own site lists its Portage Bay location as open Tue-Sat 11am-8pm and Sun 12-8pm with an online ordering link (a separate Auburn spot is marked closed permanently, with the truck for sale).
Recent coverage describes the Ballard pizzeria as currently operating Wednesday-Monday, and no closure reports turned up anywhere.
The official site currently lists active Queen Anne and Capitol Hill locations, consistent with OpenTable reviews dated into 2026 for the Capitol Hill spot.
